title: Google Photos Album Download Failure Rate
dataSources: Photo archives (`memory:takeout`), journal OCR (`memory:journal`), postcard records (`memory:postcard`), memory linking (`memory:photo`), archive checks (`memory:ops`).
app: Life-logging and memory telemetry — Google Photos Takeout archives, journal OCR queues, and postcard collection logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=memory:takeout album_name=* download_failed=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(download_failed="yes",1,0))) as matched by album_name
| eval a_failed_album_download_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - a_failed_album_download_pct
description: Measures the percentage of Takeout album exports that end with a failed album download by album.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which album are helping or hurting Takeout album exports.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `a failed album download` on `memory:takeout` events and summarize the hit rate by `album_name`.
visualization: Table of album with percentage of Takeout album exports ending with a failed album download.
grandmaExplanation: It records how often a failed album download happens for each album so you can see where Takeout album exports go smoothly or get stuck.
